verdict.rationale: Mastra is a TypeScript agent framework with a server and cloud deployment, so API versioning and a deprecation policy are fair questions to ask of it. The evidence pack never mentions API version guarantees, semver commitments, or a deprecation policy. 'Versioned datasets' (mastra-docs-17) covers evaluation data, not API versioning, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
